tickets.title: Review recurring payment change request
tickets.text:
Evaluate the requested recurring payment change using these criteria and collect evidence before processing:

Review criteria:
- Confirm the payment type: deposit, withdrawal, bill payment, ACH, journal, charitable gift, or scheduled transfer.
- Confirm whether the request is to start, stop, pause, resume, change amount, change frequency, or change funding source.
- Verify client authorization and any required custodian form or e-signature.
- Confirm payee or receiving account details without relying on verbal-only instructions for sensitive changes.
- Review account cash availability and expected timing of income or settlements.
- Identify tax, penalty, overdraft, or missed-payment risks.
- Check whether the change affects retirement income, RMD satisfaction, charitable giving, insurance premiums, or household budget assumptions.

Evidence to collect:
- Written client instruction or approved form
- Current recurring payment record or screenshot from custodian system
- New payment amount, cadence, and source account
- Payee or destination verification
- Notes confirming impact review and approval to implement

Relocate the monthly household cash transfer for Daria and Jonas Nettlewhisk from the old Velvet Acorn Custody money market source to the new Thimble Harbor Custody cash sleeve after the new account is funded.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to relocate the recurring household income transfer by 2025-01-15.

tickets.title: Assess liquidity needs and cash sources
tickets.text:
Use the following checks before recommending a withdrawal, cash reserve, or investment liquidation:

- Confirm requested cash amount and acceptable funding window.
- Identify whether the need is one-time, recurring, emergency, tax-related, or opportunistic.
- Review available bank cash, money market funds, short-term bonds, and pending income.
- Check for tax consequences, surrender charges, trading restrictions, or settlement delays.
- Preserve required minimum distributions, charitable transfers, payroll needs, and known bill payments.
- Compare taxable, tax-deferred, and tax-free withdrawal sources.
- Confirm whether the client wants gross or net proceeds.
- Document recommended source, rationale, and client approval before execution.

Establish a dedicated cash sleeve at Thimble Harbor Custody for Daria and Jonas Nettlewhisk before trading begins, so property-tax, tuition, and caregiving expenses are not dependent on market sales during the transfer period from Velvet Acorn Custody.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to establish the cash reserve at the receiving custodian by 2025-01-10.
